title: RICHARDS STREET ELEVATION

texts.text: This is a detailed architectural elevation drawing of the Iolani Palace, specifically the Richards Street facade viewed from the northwest. The drawing depicts a grand, multi-story structure featuring two prominent corner towers with spires, ornate cornices, arched windows, and detailed balustrades characteristic of Victorian-era architecture. It includes precise dimensional annotations for various architectural elements like cornices, ceilings, and floors.
WESTERN OFFICE - NATIONAL PARK SERVICE AND
DEPT OF ACCT & SER, GER, STATE OF HAWAII
UNDER DIRECTION OF THE NATIONAL PARK SERVICE.
UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR
